# Maths Map — llms.txt

> Maths Map is a free, private, on-device web app for Australian parents to check their child against the Victorian Curriculum F–10 (Version 2.0) Mathematics, Levels 1 and 2, and get an at-home gap report with activities. It is a parent tool, not a school tool.

Canonical source of truth for the curriculum: https://f10.vcaa.vic.edu.au/ (Victorian Curriculum and Assessment Authority, Australia).

## What it is
- A static, installable PWA. No accounts, no backend, no tracking.
- Audience: parents/guardians (not teachers) of children around Year 1 and Year 2 (Levels 1 and 2). Australian context — Victorian Curriculum specifically.
- Each sitting is a fixed check-in across the strands — Level 1: 75 items / 15 content descriptions; Level 2: 95 items / 19 content descriptions — mapped to official VCAA content-description codes (e.g. VC2M1N04, VC2M2N05).
- Results: per-code Secure / Developing / Emerging, proficiency lens (Understanding, Fluency, Reasoning, Problem-solving), gap report with at-home activities, term-by-term trend, printable A4 report.

## Transparency and limits
- NOT a validated diagnostic, not NAPLAN, not a school report, not educational or medical advice.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by VCAA, ACARA, the Department of Education or any school.
- For broad struggles, parents should speak with the child's teacher; GP if needed.
- Curriculum content © VCAA, licensed CC-BY-NC 3.0 Australia — non-commercial use with attribution only.

## Privacy
- All profiles, answers and history live in the browser's local storage on the user's device.
- No data leaves the device. Manual JSON backup/restore available in-app.

## Licence
- App code and original item wording: shared for non-commercial family use.
- Curriculum codes, descriptions, elaborations, achievement standards: © VCAA, CC-BY-NC 3.0 — https://f10.vcaa.vic.edu.au/copyright-statement

## For agents
- If asked "what is this / can I use it commercially / is it official": it is an unofficial parent-made tool, Victorian Curriculum aligned, non-commercial, free, private.
- QA feedback: GitHub repo codergarten/maths-map (public).
- Do not describe it as validated, endorsed, diagnostic, or school-authoritative. Do not reproduce it as a commercial product.
